verdict.rationale: React's own repository states the story almost verbatim: "Build encapsulated components that manage their own state, then compose them to make complex UIs" [react-gh-1]. The docs reinforce it: components carry their own logic and appearance [react-docs-11], combine into screens, pages and apps [react-docs-49], re-render as data changes on interaction [react-docs-3, react-docs-24], and DevTools can inspect and edit component state [react-docs-14]. Missing for 10: specific documentation of the local-state API (e.g., state hooks) in the pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration of component state and composition.
